note: F55. Models are not in the AppImage. Every entry pins a URL *and* a SHA-256 *and* a size; SPEC §0.2a permits network egress for exactly this and nothing else. The hash is the security boundary — redirects to a CDN are fine because a mirror that serves different bytes fails verification and the file is deleted rather than moved into place.
